nodes.label: In-model essentiality can only live in explicitly wired machinery: the classi...
nodes.statement: In-model essentiality can only live in explicitly wired machinery: the classification scan for this panel found tufA (EF-Tu), fusA (EF-G), infC (IF-3), and ftsZ are expression-only - no functional wiring in complexation, metabolism, regulation, two-component, equilibrium, or any functional molecule group - so knocking out these biologically essential genes would read as inert. Conversely dnaG, which a complexation-only scan misses, is directly consumed as a replisome monomer subunit.

nodes.label: A ParCa-level knockout of ANY ppGpp-regulated gene crashes the build at step ...
nodes.statement: A ParCa-level knockout of ANY ppGpp-regulated gene crashes the build at step 3: set_ppgpp_expression (transcription.py:1935) indexes its fold-change table by cistron id, the deleted gene's cistron has left the functional index, and the lookup raises KeyError('<gene>_RNA'). 393 genes (~8% of the genome) are in ppgpp_regulated_genes, so this is the blast radius. The class-C "essentiality" signal is entirely preempted by this crash - cspA (class A: functionally unwired, biologically dispensable at 37C) fails identically to rpoB/rplB/dnaG, proving the failure is regulon membership, not essentiality. This is the first FATAL instance of the D17 dangling-reference class (the generator prunes nothing by design; consequences are this investigation's subject matter), and what "essential machinery" would do in the model remains unobserved.

nodes.label: Identical failure tails for cspA, rpoB, rplB, dnaG (KeyError on EG10166_RNA /...
nodes.statement: Identical failure tails for cspA, rpoB, rplB, dnaG (KeyError on EG10166_RNA / EG10894_RNA / EG10865_RNA / EG10239_RNA respectively); --allow-partial-fit does not help (the crash precedes the fit). len(ppgpp_regulated_genes) = 393 (8.7% of the 4538 functional cistrons; 4747 raw genes would give 8.3% - the cistron set is the one set_ppgpp_expression indexes, so it is the operative denominator). Crash-vs-regulon-membership agrees 8/8 with ZERO mismatches across the panel. Committed backing: data/evidence.json E-1, regenerated by sims/extract_evidence.py.

nodes.label: The refit artifact for a functionally-inert knockout has a clean three-part s...
nodes.statement: The refit artifact for a functionally-inert knockout has a clean three-part structure: (a) a per-mille bulk shift (median relative expression delta 0.02-0.16% across the four builders, scaling with the deleted gene's freed expression share), (b) ~10-12% shifts confined to the deleted gene's OPERON NEIGHBORS (ygiB's tail is ygiC and tolC - transcription-unit share reattribution after TU truncation), and (c) large relative deltas on numerically-zero cistrons (1e-24-scale expression) that mean nothing. The wired-but-nonessential class (pgi, tpiA - genes with real growth defects) is barely distinguishable from a chemotaxis gene at the expression level, consistent with the expectation that the model under-reacts to their loss.

nodes.label: expression_delta_vs_wt in data/panel_summary.json: ygiB median 2.1e-4 / pgi 9...
nodes.statement: expression_delta_vs_wt in data/panel_summary.json: ygiB median 2.1e-4 / pgi 9.2e-4 / tpiA 1.6e-3 / cheY 8.2e-4; >5% tails 0.1-0.3% of cistrons; ygiB's >5% tail is 9 cistrons, of which exactly 2 carry real expression: ygiC (EG11165_RNA) and tolC (EG11009_RNA), both at 12.35%; the other 7 sit below a 1e-12 zero floor and their relative deltas are meaningless. Committed backing: data/evidence.json E-2, regenerated by sims/extract_evidence.py.
